entries.reason: The paired academic dis/kredit/ig/i is over-analysis for conservative Ruby; retain the attested long root diskredit and the productive ig/i suffixes.

entries.evidence: Academic has te/foliin/o. PIV2020 heads teofilin/o and shows te+foli+ino only as a derivation under foli/o; tefoliin is not itself a PIV headword.
entries.counterevidence: The PIV derivation supports internal te+foli+ino morphology, so this is explicitly a conservative annotation-display choice, not a claim that tefoliin is an official indivisible root.
entries.reason: Standalone foliin lacks an honest localized gloss in all three apps; one exact synonym-level Ruby avoids both invented annotation text and the learner's still deeper fake split.
